# opencode-console-notify 4.0.0 — macOS support

All three operating systems are now supported: **Windows 10/11, Linux, and macOS**.

## What's new

- **macOS support** — identical fullscreen config TUI (same views, keys j/k/arrows/Enter/Space, mouse hover/click/wheel, en/es language, customs panel) backed by a native darwin console backend (`console_darwin.go`, termios + TIOCGWINSZ). Notifications via `osascript` (built-in), graceful when missing. Installs without a registry (identity is the app name).
- **New dedicated macOS installer** — `install-macos.sh` (`curl | sh`), efficient: no registry step, atomic rename, install/uninstall/upgrade.
- **`install.sh` now works on macOS** too (POSIX shell, same atomic write).
- **Go CLI binary ships for darwin** — `opencode-notify-darwin-amd64` / `opencode-notify-darwin-arm64` assets attached to this release.
- **npm package** — `"darwin"` added to `package.json` `"os"`; `opencode-console-notify@4.0.0` published to npm (pnpm/npx/bun compatible).
- **CI on `macos-latest`** — Go build/vet/gofmt/tests, `install-macos.sh` + `install.sh` smoke tests, `doctor`, `test` via osascript, Node syntax check, LF guard, npm smoke.

## Install paths (pick any one)

| Platform | One-line installer |
|---|---|
| Windows | `irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/IbatoLionDev/opencode-console-notify/main/install.ps1 \| iex` |
| Linux | `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/IbatoLionDev/opencode-console-notify/main/install.sh \| sh` |
| macOS | `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/IbatoLionDev/opencode-console-notify/main/install-macos.sh \| sh` |

Or use the npm package (`npm i -g opencode-console-notify`) or the Go CLI binary attached below.

## Requirements

- OpenCode 1.18.29+ or 2.x
- No administrator rights needed

The TUI is identical on all three platforms; pipes and scripts keep line mode everywhere.

Full notes: https://github.com/IbatoLionDev/opencode-console-notify/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md#400---2026-10-18
